name: Red-billed Leiothrix
desc: Red-billed Leiothrix (Leiothrix lutea): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 1,504 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The red-billed leiothrix is a member of the family Leiothrichidae, native to southern China and the Himalayas. Adults have bright red bills and a yellowish-white ring around their eyes.
